name: Lemmy
description: Federated link aggregator and discussion forum similar to Reddit, interoperating over ActivityPub.

envVars.description: Public hostname the instance is served from

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      LEMMY_DATABASE_URL: "postgres://lemmy:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres/lemmy"
      LEMMY_HOSTNAME: {{env.LEMMY_HOSTNAME}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/pictrs:/pictrs
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: lemmy
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: lemmy
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-ui:
    image: dessalines/lemmy-ui:0.19.5
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-ui
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      LEMMY_UI_LEMMY_INTERNAL_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-app:8536"
      LEMMY_UI_LEMMY_EXTERNAL_HOST: lemmy.example.com
  {{serviceName}}-pictrs:
    image: asonix/pictrs:0.5
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-pictrs
    restart: unless-stopped
